concept: Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs, TCP/UDP and fast failover
tests: Choosing a service for UDP traffic with minimal latency, fast regional failover, and fixed IPs.
expected: AWS Global Accelerator — 2 static anycast IPs, TCP/UDP, AWS backbone, failover without DNS TTL delays. Triggers: "UDP", "fixed IPs for an allow-list", "near-instant regional failover", "lowest latency".
why_not: CloudFront is HTTP/HTTPS caching only, no fixed IPs for UDP; Route 53 latency routing depends on DNS TTL; API Gateway is HTTP/REST/WebSocket.
